name: hxc
description: EXPERIMENTAL: a C target for Haxe. `haxe -lib hxc -main Main --custom-target hxc=bin/main`: your Haxe types the program, the bundled haxe-in-haxe backend turns it into C and a C compiler (or cosmocc, for a static portable binary) builds it.
releasenote: The program is typed by the user's Haxe and handed over as HXB; one haxe call builds the binary.
